svg.title: 11-temperature-solution
svg.desc: Symbolic solution workflow on the same actual152-atom silicon structure: fixed boundary temperatures TL and TR, unknown local thermal-source parameters T1,Ti,TN, zero integrated power Ji=0 for each local section, the solved set of temperature parameters, then boundary heat current. Probe attachments are to complete three-cell example supports, not individual atoms. The three displayed sections and dots represent the repeated local construction. There is no invented numerical temperature, gradient, spatial profile, fitting curve, or computed phonon population. The hot/cold boundary symbols and current arrows are model boundary conditions and current directions, not new calculation data. Conventional repeat0.543356003nm, selected interaction length9.237052051nm, full length10.323764057nm. The formulae and energy-balance equations are supplied above this explanatory figure.
